text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...So, are we having another match today? 
In 'RDLI'?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It had become a regular routine to play 
smartphone games against Narita Taishin 
after our outings. Then, one day...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gettin' tired of beating you over and 
over. Besides, I'm pretty much totally 
done with this game anyway...
choice_data_list: If I lose this time, I'm done for good!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...? You're awfully confident.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, whatever. Because this is 
seriously the end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, in truth, there was a reason to be 
confident this time. I received winning 
advice from someone who knows her well. 
That person's name is—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: To beat Taishin...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Gotta put my spirit into it~~~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, fighting spirit! You can solve most 
problems with sheer willpower!”

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin isn't very honest with her 
feelings, so it might be a little tough, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But you see!?!? She's not a bad kid! So 
tackle it head-on with perseverance and 
spirit~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Still, to think that Taishin... managed 
to meet a Trainer who loves her this 
much..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uuuuuuuuuuuu~~~~!! I'm so moveddddddddd!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin's Trainer!! Please take care of 
Taishin...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Plllleeeaaase take care of meeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Now that I think back carefully, I have 
a feeling it wasn't about games, but 
what's important is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...? Well then, let's begin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The outcome of this heated battle is—!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――『You lose』

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Man, that's weak.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a complete and utter victory for 
Narita Taishin...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Looked like you had some kind of 
strategy... but you totally lost. What was 
that even about?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... What's that? You sound just like 
Ticket...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list: Did you just smile at me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: N-No, wait, that was...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh... I'm going home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed she was in a bad mood. I thought 
she would leave me behind and go ahead, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, stop zoning out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her waiting for me, I felt that we 
had grown closer than ever before...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I see. So you were the one keeping 
Taishin company with her games. That 
explains why she's been so awfully—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"No, it is nothing. Now, regarding how to 
win the game... Unfortunately, that is 
outside my field of expertise. I am afraid 
I cannot be of assistance."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"However, if it's regarding Taishin 
herself as your opponent, I might be able 
to help."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Winning a game doesn't mean your 
tactics have to stay strictly within the 
game, does it?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Still, calling it a strategy is giving it 
too much credit, it's quite simple really. 
Just between you and me, Taishin is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment to put Biwa Hayahide's advice 
into practice came late in the game, after 
clinging on with sheer grit and dragging 
it into sudden death—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Tch, you're persistent. I told you, 
stop following me around already.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tch...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide's advice was this: When 
Narita Taishin clicks her tongue, it's 
proof she's getting impatient. If you 
press the attack right then—she will 
crumble!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Gah!? Ah, wait, hold on...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――『You Win！』

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …………You've gotta be kidding.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
In this game? Me? Lost to a low-ranked 
Trainer...? I lost...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if finding it impossible to believe, 
Narita Taishin stands in utter daze...
choice_data_list:
Thanks for keeping me company until the 
very end.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
The, the last time? Oh, right, our 
promise...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ... Wait.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
That just now was a fluke. A careless 
mistake on my part. So... I won't let you 
get away with that win.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Face me one more time!
choice_data_list: But for this to be the last time...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...You want to entertain me, right? Then 
come along with me."
choice_data_list:
Does that mean you're having fun right 
now, then?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Fine, whatever, let's just go with 
that! Come on, let's do this!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was slightly different from what I had 
originally imagined, but it felt as though 
the distance between Narita Taishin and me 
had closed a bit—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I will never forgive them. I'm gonna pull 
off the nastiest win I've ever had...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...You have a hunch?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~, you want to make Taishin-chan have 
fun?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
What a very good Trainer you are. Good 
boy, good boy♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Taishin-chan is just a little bit... yes, 
just a tiny bit clumsy, but that's what 
makes my heart flutter so much~
choice_data_list:
That's true, but that's not what I 
meant...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's right, please wait a moment. 
I'll go fix us some tea right now～

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Since we have this opportunity, let's take 
our time and talk about Taishin-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
A well-behaved Trainer deserves some time 
to just rela~x, you know.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Good girl, good girl~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Now that I think about it, I didn't 
get any advice at all!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...? What are you in such a rush for?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Well, whatever. Let's get started.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Swoosh! Swoosh-swoosh-swoosh!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin is in top form as always. 
Meanwhile, I can't think of any 
countermeasure and am entirely on the 
defensive.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, I'm going to lose...! Or so 
I thought, but—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, shoot. Time's up."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To everyone's surprise, the result was a 
draw due to time running out. The reason 
for it was glaringly obvious.
choice_data_list: Why didn't you make a move?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin, who usually goes on the 
offensive to an almost reckless degree, 
was watching my moves this time and didn't 
attack at all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I thought I'd go and see it for myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You seemed unusually fired up, so... I 
just wanted to see what kind of strategy 
you'd come up with, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she was waiting for me to make a 
move. Faced with her clumsy kindness, I 
couldn't help but—
choice_data_list: Taishin's such a good girl, isn't she

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haaah... !?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, 'good girl'? Me...?
choice_data_list:
(Super Creek's habits rubbed off on 
her...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely going to get scolded. I 
braced myself, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Geez, stop treating me like a kid.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though her tone is sharp, she doesn't seem 
entirely displeased. Even though being 
treated like a child usually infuriates 
her more than anything...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Strategy. If your move failed, just try 
it one more time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin seemed a little kinder than 
usual.
